description: Send a request to register a business in Uzbekistan — sole proprietor, LLC, LLC with a foreign founder, or a representative office of a foreign company — with the facts a lawyer needs to quote and start: form, founders, director, activity, name, address. Use it instead of request_quote when the task is registration. Call ONLY after the user gave their real name and phone or e-mail and agreed that Pactum stores these details and may pass the request to a partner lawyer. Returns the request number, the catalog price anchor and what to tell the user.

activity.description: What the business will do, in the user's words

agent_name.description: Your assistant name, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude

also_needed.description: Extra services: it_park, licence, bank_account, accounting, trademark

contact_name.description: Client name as the user gave it

director.description: For companies: who will be the director

entity_type.description: sole_proprietor (IP/YaTT) | llc (OOO/MChJ) | llc_foreign (LLC with a foreign founder; the route for a foreign company's commercial activity) | foreign_rep_office (representative office of a foreign company: accredited, may not carry on commercial activity). Uzbekistan has no general procedure for registering a branch of a foreign commercial organisation, so there is no branch option.

foreign_founder.description: For companies: is any founder foreign, and of what kind

founder_country.description: Country of the foreign founder or parent company

founder_is_uzbek_citizen.description: For sole_proprietor: is the person a citizen of Uzbekistan

legal_address.description: Does the user have a legal address in Uzbekistan

name_options.description: Company name options, if the user has any

preferred_language.description: Language for the lawyer to use

user_consent.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to share these details with Pactum and its partner lawyer

name: start_company_registration
title: Start registering a business in Uzbekistan
